text: This is my go-to clinic; I wouldn't dare go to another because I'm so impressed with Dr. Nita. She's lovely, gentle, beautiful, and gives excellent advice. I've had braces since I was in university, and my sibling also got braces here when they were young. I'm very impressed with her; she takes great care of my teeth, speaks so nicely, and is incredibly lovely. I highly recommend her! 🦷🪥🥼🩺👩‍⚕️ Dr. Nita is so beautiful, and Dr. Tawee does beautiful veneers too! Anyone interested can come; she's located in Saphan Mai.

text: The patient had a toothache accompanied by a fever. The tooth shouldn't have been extracted, but it was done anyway. The patient subsequently experienced chills, high fever, dizziness, and vomiting. There was no answer at the phone number provided. If inflammation and a severe infection occur, how will the clinic take responsibility? The clinic should uphold professional ethics. Seeing that the patient was a child, why didn't they provide the appropriate advice based on their training regarding whether or not the tooth was suitable for extraction?
